package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// CourseTechRepoPG implements CourseTechRepository.
type CourseTechRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Add links course to tech.
func (r CourseTechRepoPG) Add(ctx context.Context, courseID string, techID int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_tech (course_id, tech_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
		courseID, techID)
	return err
}

// Replace updates course tech links to exact set.
func (r CourseTechRepoPG) Replace(ctx context.Context, courseID string, techIDs []int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM course_tech WHERE course_id=$1`, courseID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, techID := range techIDs {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_tech (course_id, tech_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, courseID, techID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.CourseTechRepository = (*CourseTechRepoPG)(nil)
